text: Nirait Shin-Ilu is a Dunmer Barbarian who resides in the Ashlands of Morrowind. He and his companion Kanat Assalatammis can be found in their camp north of Maar Gan. When the Nerevarine approaches the camp they become hostile.
Norionil is an Altmer Witchhunter who resides within the region of Bitter Coast located in Morrowind.
Nitch is a named imp and a champion of the Toothmaul Gully public dungeon in Auridon. Killing Nitch counts towards the "Toothmaul Gully Conqueror" and "Toothmaul Gully Vanquisher" achievements.
Noldir is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is one of Queen Ayrenn's guards while she stays in Auridon.
Nolinore is an Altmer carpenter residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Nongiruin is a Bosmer chef residing in the town of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Niraniel is a Bosmer residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Nithleen is a Redguard residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. When the Vestige arrive she is hiding in one of the two Watchtowers.
Noisy-Hunter is a Khajiit found in Mournhold. She is a slave owned by House Dres.
Nivis Hlaalu is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu residing in Mournhold.
Nolu-Azza is an Argonian in who resides at Plantation Point Overlook in the region of Bal Foyen.
Nonde is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion residing in General Marenil's House in the Western Elsweyr Gate in Cyrodiil.
Nolore Jeanne is a Breton patron of the Sleepy Sailor Inn in Koeglin Village.
Nojaxia is an Argonian alchemist who resides in Lukiul Uxith in Stonefalls, Morrowind.
Noculvon is an Altmer moneylender residing in the Davon's Watch Outlaws Refuge.
Njorfar the Gossip is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm.
Nirthongoth is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Windhelm.
Nokhailaedhaz is a Goblin and the chieftain of the Sandgrubber Tribe. He is found inside Divad's Chagrin Mine, where he acts as the boss of the delve along with his ogre bodyguard, Even Bigger.
Nomeg Zozumiralpachar is a powerful Frost Atronach found in the ruins of Balamath.
Nodeeus is an Argonian mystic and member of the Mages Guild residinh in Shor's Stone. He is found at the local branch, selling his wares.
Norgred Hardhelm is the Nord who can be found alongside his wife Evigna just east of the Obsidian Gorge Wayshrine.
Nivrilin is a Bosmer scout of the Aldmeri Dominion. Her and the rest of her party were captured by Ebonheart Pact soldiers found at the Reconnaissance Camp in Greenshade.
Norarubel is an Altmer found in the city of Orsinium. He is impossible to interact with, but can be seen talking to Iirdilin.
Nomeg Haga is a Frost Atronach that appears in . They are a named creature that appears sometimes in Dark Anchors.
Njordunn Oath-Breaker is a Nord and the leader of the Frostedge Pillagers, a local gang of bandits found on Bleakrock Isle.
Nistel is a Bosmer sailor who is located at Shattered Shoals.
Norerama is an Altmer moneylender and member of the Thieves Guild residing in the Thieves Den in the city of Abah's Landing.
Nomu-Goh is an Argonian slave working at Velmont Mansion in Abah's Landing.
Nolulnarian is an Altmer residing in the Barracks House in Wayrest. He is sheltering from the Dreugh attack. He has no unique dialogue.
Nirite is an Altmer found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Nithena at-Khorajah is a Redguard bard found in Silverhoof Vale.
Nirilrel is an Altmer farmer residing in Phaer and located in Eambar's House. She has no unique dialogue.
Nolunbarel is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She can be found with the rest of her team at Eagle's Strand.
Norirtil the Nefarious is an Altmer partaking in fights at the Thizzrini Arena.
Nirolos is a Bosmer and one of many who were mysteriously drawn to Vinedeath Cave by Madruin, a mad spirit found within.
Nistyniel is a Bosmer guild trader. She sells her wares at her stall at The Hollow Market in the Hollow City.
Nithelin is a Bosmer brewer selling her wares at her tent in Karthdar.
Nondor is a Bosmer scholar of the Mages Guild. He is part of the expedition taking place in the Reliquary of Stars.
Noemie Frinck is a Breton soldier in residing in Velyn Harbor.
Norine Conrele is a Breton noble residing in Skywatch. She is found dancing on stage at The Mercantile.
Nivama Hlor is a Dunmer soldier of House Hlaalu. She is part of the contingent battling the Maulborn Cult in the Obsidian Gorge.
Nivene Orthil is a Dunmer reveler. She has lost her way inside the Hall of the Dead while on a dare with her drinking companions.
Noreni Aryon is a Dunmer soldier of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Norasa Relvi is a Dunmer found inside the castle of Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Niro Clinius is an Imperial commoner and member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Abah's Landing.
Nompar Stieve is a Breton residing in Kvatch. He stands on the path behind the bank.
Nizil-dar is a Khajiit brewer of the Baandari Clan. He sells his wares at his stall, Foggy Nog Brewers, in their camp at the Martyr's Crossing.

Nix-Oxen arthropod creatures that appear in . They are found roaming the Grazelands, and while said to be very mild-mannered, they do not hesitate to defend their territory. According to the book, Dark Elves, Dark Hearts, there are two distinct groups of Nix-Oxen: Nix-Tovo, and Nix-Rima, with Tovo being older and larger, whereas Rima are smaller, but more expensive at market.
Njorlund Steel-Wind is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact and the son of Gerent Saervild. He accompanies him on his assignment at Bogmother.
Nordahl was a Nord Worm Cultist that led the cell excavating Forelhost. Him and his men were killed when the draugr were raised from their graves.
Noam Derre is a Breton in Firemoth Island on Vvardenfell. He is a relative of Jossen Derre.
Nivayn Morvayn is a Dunmer scholar found in the Saint Delyn Waistworks of Vivec City on Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Nirajlar is a male Khajiit in Vos on Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue, and can be seen sitting in front of a Savarak Loyalist.
Nivan Dulni is a Dunmer student and member of the Clockwork Apostles found in the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Nirai Sathil is a Dunmer member of House Sathil. She is the daughter of Hleryn Sathil.
Nix-Hound Prowler is a Nix-Hound in the Zainsipilu delve in .
Noloen Jerick is a Breton who can be found to the east of the Traitor's Vault in Artaeum, surrounded by sheep. He cannot be interacted with.
Nixxie is a named Nix-Hound that appears during the "Bound by Love" quest. He is trained by Llonas Givyn to gather red star shells.

Nirshala is a Khajiit guild trader that resides in Rimmen. She is located at Rimmen Commerce Exchange at her stand, Meandering Moons Boutique. Although she's already in a guild, she still looks for a guild that offers a better opportunity.
Nizran is a Redguard residing in Kerbol's Hollow. He can be found on the corner near the forge and Themond' House.
No-Holds Zabzhar is a Khajiit residing at in The Stitches, Northern Elsweyr fighting with Bare-Knuckle Bidandar. He has no unique dialogue.
Nomo-Rerak, Arbiter of Pain is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses melee attacks.
Noebelle Ginis is a Breton in Northern High Rock Gate who can be found at the base of the Enchanter's Tower, Cyrodiil in .
Nisswo Ajul-Jas is an Argonian priest of Sithis residing in the Bog Brokers marketplace at northern Lilmoth.
Nirenan is a character located in the Bone Orchard, Grahtwood, in . She guards the entrance to the Heart of the Barrowbough.
Nummu is a Dunmer Herder who resides in the Ashlander Ahemmusa Camp. She is a herder. Nummu spends most of her time in her yurt.
Norring is a Nord Warrior living in Ebonheart. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion. He is imprisoned in the Hawkmoth Legion Garrison in Ebonheart.
Nurelion is an elderly and rather ill-tempered Altmer alchemist who runs the White Phial with his apprentice, Quintus Navale, in Windhelm.
Noster Eagle-Eye is an Imperial beggar living in the streets of Solitude.
Nura Snow-Shod is a Nord priestess of Talos residing in the city of Riften. She is a member of the Snow-Shod clan.
Numeen is an Argonian living in Leyawiin with her husband Mahei.

Novor Gorvas is a Dunmer crusader and guard residing in the Guard Quarters in Venim Manor, Ald'ruhn. He is one of Venim's kinsmen guarding the captive Varvur Sarethi, held in a secret room in Venim Manor. Novor is otherwise not involved in any quests, and does not provide any unique information.
Nurisea Selarys is a Dunmer Archer in the Hlaalu Ancestral Vaults in Vivec City.
Nothasea Beni is a Dunmer savant residing in the cavern of Nallit.

Nurnhilde, the eldest child of Mabjaarn Flame-Hair, was the heir to the throne of Windhelm, and briefly the High Queen of Eastern Skyrim. She was killed, along with her mother, during the Sack of Windhelm. During the Three Banners War, her body and the Crown of Freydis were stolen from the royal crypts at Fort Morvunskar by her brother Fildgor Orcthane. He hoped to use sorcery to merge his sister's spirit with his so that the Crown would accept him as the High King of Skyrim. Nurnhilde enlisted the Vestige's aid, and Fildgor was stopped in Sovngarde as he was trying to merge with his sister's spirit.
Nund Assurnipilu is a Dunmer Barbarian who resides in the Ashlands of Morrowind.
Nummu Assudiraplit is an Dunmer Mabrigash who resides outside of Ashamanu Camp, which is located in the region of Azura's Coast of Morrowind.
Nurisipa is a Khajiit pack merchant. She sells her wares at her stall, Enormous Storage Solutions, at the Tradesman's Square in Daggerfall.
Nuralg is an Argonian Slave who resides in the slave cave of Zebabi.

Nosaleeth is an Argonian found in the city of Mournhold. He stands at the Mournhold docks waiting for a boat to take him and others who were invited to the Academy of Magic. When spoken with Nosaleeth asks how the Vestige received an invitation.
Nuthanda is a Khajiit residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Nulk is a Khajiit residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Nulla is a Khajiit working at the Laughing Moons Plantation.
Noryon is an Altmer found at Sarandel's Carnival in Grahtwood. He works as a storyteller, but is hesitant to tell the stories he knows.
Nulion is an Altmer magus residing in the local guilhall of the Mages Guild in Marbruk. He is usually found in the guild's main hall.
Nuza is an Orsimer residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth.
Nuifa is a Khajiit part of the gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Belkarth.
Nostrum Breva is a Dunmer member of the Maulborn Cult. She leads their forces in the catacombs underneath Quarantine Serk.
Nurvyna Drim is a Dunmer brewer. She works at the Caravan Company Depot in Dragonstar.
Nunkuk gro-Roguk is an Orsimer residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. He can be found regarding the stocks in the Town Square. He has no unique dialogue.
Nullius Filius is an Imperial fence and part of the gang found inside the outlaws refuge beneath Wayrest.
Nuzah is a Redguard commoner residing at the Sisters of the Sands Inn in the city of Sentinel. She has no unique dialogue.
Nurara Mothran is a Dunmer residing in the city of Windhelm. She is Tildsi Mothran's daughter, and is being courted by Atald Cold-Moon. She cannot be interacted with.
Numithir is an Altmer relaxing northeast of Headman Bhosek's Palace in Port Hunding, in the region of Stros M'Kai. He has no unique dialogue.
Nurwuuisse is an Altmer residing in Watch Captain Astanya's Home in Vulkhel Guard. She has no unique dialogue.
Nuduxith is a Argonian residing in Sanguine's Demesne in the region of Shadowfen.
Nuresse Larouche is a Breton residing in the city of Orsinium.
Nubaree is an Argonian alchemist and owner of Nubaree's Experiments in the city of Stormhold.
Nurad is a Khajiit found at the College of Aldmeri Propriety.
Nugwugg is an Orsimer slave residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane, and located in the store "This One Sells Glyphs."
Noryariel is an Altmer. She sells her wares at her stall, The Glass Bobbin, at the Moonfire Forge in Mistral.
Not-So-Quick is an Argonian residing in Lukiul Uxith. He is helping his friend Nojaxia with her attempt at joining the Mages Guild.
Nukorash the Healer is an Argonian residing at the Percolating Mire.
Norweras is a Bosmer residing in Cormount. She is a partisan of the newly reformed Blacksap Rebellion.
Nothirvir is a Bosmer member of the Vinedusk Rangers. He is found at their headquarters in Vinedusk Village.
Nothrelras is a Bosmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is found in Eagle's Strand.
Nothrolion is a Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful in . He is found at the Falinesti Winter Site.
Nuledhi is a Khajiit beggar found within The Middens underneath Elden Root.
Nuula Seran is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is the armsman of their branch in Abah's Landing.
Nuhunza is a Khajiit banker. She works at the bank in Windhelm.
Numu is a Khajiit found at the Temple of Two-Moons Dance in Khenarthi's Roost.
Novor Sarothran is a Dunmer residing in Seyda Neen and can be found sanding wood outside the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City, on Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Novice Feranos is a Dunmer mage and a member of House Telvanni residing at the Council House in Sadrith Mora on Vvardenfell.
Nrio Abor is an Imperial laborer found at the bridge east of Marandus. He cannot be interacted with.
Nothas Vules is a Dunmer stablemaster residing in Balmora, in Vvardenfell. She is a member of the Fate-Bearers.
Numaheh is a Redguard found in Shornhelm. She has no unique dialogue.
Nuhar is a Khajiit commoner found in Ealaren's House in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Nunaacil is an Altmer sitting on a bench in a park near the Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Nunalhros is an Altmer sleeping in a room on the upper floor of the Anchors Aweigh Inn in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Nunelneandil is an Altmer found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Norwess is a Redguard who can be found in the Faculty Hall in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Noura is a Redguard warrior fighting in the Arena. She can be found standing nearby Henrik Seven-Swords in the Town.
Nurdan is an Argonian commoner of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village. She has no unique dialogue.
Nulaga is a Khajiit zither-player who appears in the Banished Regrets Inn in Riverhold, Northern Elsweyr. Other then the songs she continually sings, she has no dialogue.
Nurhei is an Argonian trader residing in Lilmoth. He was a business associate of the late Keema-Ru.
Numani-Rasi is a Dunmer member of the Urshilaku Tribe who can be found in Ald'ruhn, Vvardenfell. She appears after completion of the quests "Ancestral Ties" and "Ashlander Relations."
Numaia is a Khajiit ranch owner that can be found near the Prowl hunting grounds. She has a number of people working under her, caring for the various beasts that she rescued from hunters.
Nuxal is an Argonian residing at Lilmoth. She has no unique dialogue.

Nuulion was a master smith from Summerset Isles who lived during the Second Era. He is known for having kept the Dunmer Ulvul Llaren as a slave and for guarding the secrets of crafting Elven armour from moonstone and quicksilver.
Ocheeva is an Argonian assassin, one of the rarely seen Shadowscales along with her brother Teinaava, and a member of the Cheydinhal Sanctuary of the Dark Brotherhood in .

Ocato of Firsthold was a pivotal Altmer mage in the Third Empire of Tamriel in the latter years of the Third Era, and the beginning of the Fourth. Ocato was once a long-standing member of the Elder Council, and the defeat of Jagar Tharn at the hands of Uriel Septim VII's Eternal Champion promoted Ocato to being one of the few known Imperial Battlemages of the Empire. This position he served during the Nerevarine Prophecy, and during the Oblivion Crisis. In the Crisis' conclusion, the Septim Dynasty became extinct. Ocato was then appointed as Potentate of the Empire, leading in an emperor's stead until one could be found; a position that would cost him his life, leaving Ocato assassinated in
Odairan Ashummi-Ammus is a Dunmer Commoner in Caldera, Morrowind. He is located in his house.
Okur is an Argonian commoner residing at her home in Hla Oad, Morrowind. Her claims of being haunted by a restless spirit have caught the attention of a high-ranking Imperial Cult member.

Odron Omoran is a Dunmer who resides in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He is a Buoyant Armiger and a novice member of the Tribunal Temple, residing at the Armigers Stronghold in the city's waistworks. Odron does not provide any services and is not involved in any quests.
Okan-Shei is an Argonian Savant who lives in Ebonheart, Morrowind. He can be found in the East Empire Company offices.

Ohtimbar is an Altmer member of the Fighters Guild in who resides in his home, Cheydinhal in the early morning hours each day. He holds the rank of Guardian, which only three other members have reached, Azzan, Burz gro-Khash and Keld of the Isles. He used to be a combatant in the Arena, but got out while he "still had the standard set of arms, legs and ears."

Ogier Georick is a Breton who owns The Main Ingredient in the Market District of the Imperial City. Georick sells alchemical ingredients and equipment. He is also one of the few merchants in Cyrodiil who sells Cyrodilic Brandy.
Odmi is a Nord witchhunter who resides in the vampire hideout of Ashmelech.
Octieve San is a Breton retiree who lives in Solitude. With an Amulet of Mara, the Dragonborn has the option of marrying Octieve.
Ogmund is a Nord bard who lives in Markarth. He serves as an expert Speech trainer.
Olava the Feeble is an Elder Nord fortune teller who lives in Whiterun. During the day, she is usually seen outside her house sitting on the bench. Her house is located behind Breezehome.
Oengul War-Anvil is a Nord blacksmith living in the Blacksmith Quarters of Windhelm.
Ogol is an Orsimer living in the Orc stronghold of Largashbur. He is available as a follower to the Dragonborn after completing the quest "The Cursed Tribe."
Odar is a Nord cook who works and lives in the Blue Palace in Solitude.
Odfel is a Nord miner who resides at his house in the town of Shor's Stone.
Oglub is an Orsimer warrior who works at the Dushnikh Mine, within stronghold of Dushnikh Yal.

Obeth Arnesian is an unseen character mentioned in Sinderion's Field Journal. According to the journal, Obeth was a treasure-hunter who had been exploring Blackreach, when he came upon what he had assumed was just a "noisy red weed." Being unsuccessful in finding anything else of value, he took the weed, hoping to find someone who would find it of value. After much searching, he tracked down Sinderion, a Nirnroot enthusiast in Skingrad, Cyrodiil. Sinderion paid Obeth 1,000 septims, and they never crossed paths again.
Oghash gra-Magul is an Orsimer Rogue living in the city of Cheydinhal.
Oitos, also known as Magister Oitos, was a magister of the House of Julianos in Sentinel.
Okaw is a Argonian slave who has been captured and resides in the cave Addamasartus.
Oghma, also called the Wife of All Enigma, was the wife of Xarxes and bearer of the same name as the Oghma Infinium. She was created from Xarxes' favorite moments in History.
Ohibaal Assintashiran is a Dunmer miner residing in Caldera Mine.

Odaishah Yasalmibaal is a Dunmer Barbarian. He lives in Bensiberib Camp inside his yurt. The camp is located on Azura's Coast. The reason Odaishah is living in the camp is because he is hiding from the Morag Tong. This is because the Morag Tong have a writ which Odaishah is the target of.
Ogrumbu gro-Bugarn is an Orsimer Knight residing in Valenvaryon.

Lorin is an Altmer officer of the Thalmor on the island Khenarthi's Roost in Elsweyr. She is charged with keeping peace in Khenarthi's Roost, and can be found investigating the fire at the Speckled Shell Plantation.

Ogmir is a Nord ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed and the ghosts have returned to the temple. He can be found kneeling before Skavwulf the Maul with Belknar and Hrorleid. He cannot be directly interacted with.
Odette Vinielle is a Breton member of the Mages Guild in their camp at the Glenumbra Moors.
Odairan Addaribantes is a Dunmer scout who resides in the Azura's Coast region of Vvardenfell.
Ogmash the Mighty is an Orsimer boss at the Obsidian Scar public dungeon. Defeating him counts towards the "Champions of the Obsidian Scar" and "Terror of Obsidian Scar" achievements.
Oinara is an Altmer innkeeper who resides in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard, and can be found in the Salted Wings Tavern, where she is the innkeeper.
Ocandur is an Altmer tailor. He sells his wares at his store, Aegis of Auri-El, in Vulkhel Guard.
Ograt is an Orsimer blacksmith residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. He owns the stall, Ograt's Murder Market, at the market near the docks, where he sells various weapons.
Nuzalu is a Khajiit smith residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Odei Philippe is a Breton who is found near Cambray Pass, Glenumbra, in . He is hiding by the tree near the southern end of the pass. His wife, Dame Veronica, is looking for him.
Ohtaari is an Altmer residing in Port Hunding on the island of Stros M'Kai. She can be found inside the local inn, Doom and Draughts. She has no unique dialogue.
Ograh the Kind is an Orsimer residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He is found around town.
Ohtmir is an Altmer living in the Altmer Embassy in Elden Root.
Ohtandilwe is an Altmer residing in the city of Dawnbreak, in Auridon.
Odesa Girith is a Dunmer residing inside her house in Mournhold.
Odvar is a Nord leatherworker of the Mages Guild. She sells her wares at her stall, Lustrous Leatherwear by Odvar, at the merchants' circle of Eyevea.
Octarianus is an Imperial member of the Gold Coast Mercenaries. He is found at the Silver Moons Inn in the Baandari Trading Post.
Ogularz gro-Ogdula is an Orsimer commoner residing in the city of Wayrest.
Ohartalmo is an Altmer member of the Undaunted found at the enclave in the city of Wayrest.
Odrasa Saram is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found in Fort Amol.
Odyna is a Dunmer hunter of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found in Fort Amol.
Officer Parwinel is a Bosmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is tasked with dealing and overseeing The Gray Mire, a settlement of peaceful Argonians.
Olarion is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild. He acts as the magister of their branch in Hoarfrost Downs.
Old Bjornen is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm, Eastmarch.
Officer Keesekeeth is an Argonian and a corrupt member of the Stormhold City Guard part of the group of outlaws found beneath the city.
Ogarendir is a Bosmer residing in the Mages Guild in Elden Root.
Ogumalg is an Orsimer member of the Barkbite Clan residing in the city of Reman's Bluff, Grahtwood.
Oaken-Heart-and-Head is an Argonian residing in the town of Shor's Stone.
Obaxith is an Argonian in who resides at the Bal Foyen Dockyards.

Octavimus Bincal is an Imperial residing in Cropsford. He is married to Marina Bincal, and both have their residence in Bincal House. He was once under the employment of the crime boss Niro Gratas, residing in the city of Bravil, until he chose to flee to Cropsford with Marina.
Odrys Drim is a Dunmer bard performing at The Hissing Guar in Kragenmoor, Stonefalls.
Obgol gro-Urish is an Orsimer member of the Lion Guard residing in the Bangkorai Garrison, Bangkorai.
Olarz the Cunning is a Reachman member of the Winterborn Clan. He is tasked with ambushing travelers coming from the Merchant's Gate.

Oghezai is an Ogrim in that is found in the Hoarvor Pit. When the Vestige first finds him, he is chained to the ground, being fed on by Hoarvors, and he must be freed to be fought. The Vestige is required to defeat him to clear Hoarvor Pit and get the achievement Hoarvor Pit Explorer.
Obdeg is an Orsimer noble located in Morkuldin Haven, Wrothgar.
Octivien Luillier is a Breton found in the outlaws refuge beneath Daggerfall.
Nyomie Gemane is a Breton scholar residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Odeel-Tul is an Argonian residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Ocanim is an Altmer residing in the town of Shattered Grove, Auridon.
Obrash is an Orsimer merchant found offering his services in Wayshriner's Wares near Gold Coast Wayshrine in the Gold Coast.
Odvild Wealdwalker is a Nord tending to her ill brother Alforunn at the Pilgrim's Rest Inn in Ivarstead.
Odeel-Medul is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at the Earth Forge.
Odeel-Shehs is an Argonian soldier of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Olahanar is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at the Earth Forge.
Odlynd is a Nord commoner found inside Cloya's house at the Sulfur Pools. She cannot be interacted with.
Oceane Coravel is a Breton bard performing at the Cloudy Dregs Inn in Wayrest.
Odyle Pellegrin is a Breton mercenary merchant and a member of the Daggerfall Covenant. She sells her wares at the Southern High Rock Gate.
Obetta is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Ogondar is a Nord brewer in who is working at the Crossroads Tavern in Belkarth. He is the owner of a winery outside the town.
Octavia is an Imperial and the leader of the bandit gang found within Bearclaw Mine.
Odunn Gray-Sky is a Nord residing in Ivarstead. He is seeking help to rid himself of his bug infestation.
Okula is a Nord member of the Ternion Monks found in Mistwatch.

Nuzhimeh is a summonable Redguard merchant who will become available once the Nuzhimeh the Merchant upgrade from the Crown Store is installed. She can be summoned at any location throughout Tamriel, except Cyrodiil.
Obenion is a Bosmer moneylender who runs Thieves' Trove Finances in the outlaws refuge underneath Vivec City.
Okulald is a Nord treasure hunter that can be found with his partner Inalion at various locations throughout Cyrodiil. If approached, they will turn hostile and attack.

Nycotic Brute is a generic character residing in several locations in Vvardenfell. They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be used to avoid them in combat.

Nycotic Lurker is a generic character residing in several locations in Vvardenfell. They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be used to avoid them in combat.

Nycotic Vanguard is a generic character residing in several locations in Vvardenfell. They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be used to avoid them in combat.
Oathbound Infantry is a generic Infantry character residing in . They were members of the Oathbound Clan.
Obb, Carver of Souls is a Xivkyn in . He may be found in the Imperial City Sewers. He mainly uses melee attacks.
Ohlinonde is an Altmer mystic of the Mages Guild found in one of the rooms on the first floor of the Mages Guildhall in Shimmerene, Summerset.
Olanbrim is an Altmer found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He is in the process of transporting several exotic creatures to Sil-Var-Woad.
Okan-Jeen is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in Derkeehez's House in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Ogodosh is an Orsimer that is found taking shelter inside Elinhir Sewerworks, in Elinhir, in order to hide from the Blackcaster Mages Guild.
King Ohatan was the ruler of the city-state of Dragonstar, Hammerfell, between at least 3E 389 and 3E 399.
Okan-Julan is an Argonian residing at Lilmoth. He has no unique dialogue.
Ondres Nerano is a Dunmer Merchant living in Balmora. He is living in his own manor in the western part of town. He is also a member of House Hlaalu.
.]] Olms, also known as Saint Olms the Just, is a saint of the Tribunal Temple and the Patron of chandlers and clerks.
Olumba gro-Bolgar is an Orsimer Monk living in Caldera, Morrowind. Olumba is an initiate of the Imperial Cult.
The Old Orc is an Orsimer who appears as a random encounter in Skyrim.
Omluag is a Breton who lives in Markarth. He can be found working on or around the smelter, or in the Warrens at night.

Olfina Gray-Mane is a Nord barmaid in Whiterun. She is a part of the Gray-Mane clan and will become housecarl to Vignar Gray-Mane if he becomes Jarl of Whiterun, following the Battle for Whiterun's end in the favor of the Stormcloaks.
Olfrid Battle-Born is a Nord magnate and the patriarch of the Battle-Born clan in Whiterun.

Oleed-Ei is an Argonian member of the Blackwood Company in Leyawiin. He is in charge of training new recruits in stealth based skills. He is only found in the Construction Set and not in the actual game.

On-Staya Sundew is an Argonian working as a steward at the Castle Leyawiin in Leyawiin. She is also the chief advisor to the Count Marius Caro, at least in theory, as she explains when the Hero interacts with her.
Omesu Hlarys is a Dunmer Enforcer and member of House Hlaalu, who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton. She is found within the same room as Dram Bero inside St. Olms Haunted Manor.
Olquar is an Altmer Enchanter, and a member of the Imperial Cult. He can be found at Buckmoth Legion Fort.
Ondar Sarendas is a Dunmer Rogue and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He is located on the bottom level of the stronghold's keep.

Ollrod is a Nord member of the Dawnguard who can be found scouting the outer walls of Fort Dawnguard in Dayspring Canyon. He will only appear if the Dragonborn has sided with the Dawnguard during the main quest and "A New Order" has been completed.

Ondjage, known as the Fell Wolf, was the name of the infamous wolf that devoured Hrothmund the Red. In , the Nerevarine is tasked with gaining entrance to Hrothmund's Barrow. To do so, they must speak the name of the beast that killed Hrothmund.
Olvyne Dobar is a Dunmer who can be found in Godsreach. She is in the basment of the vacant manor.
Olugush is an Orsimer soldier of the Daggerfall Covenant found in Dragonstar, Stormhaven.
Oleen-Gei is an Argonian Slave who resides in the cave of Kudanat.
Olink-Nur is an Argonian slave residing in the cave of Shushan in the Molag Amur region.
On-Wazei is an Argonian Slave residing in the cave of Sinsibadon.
Olgus is a Nord mercenary hired by Ranabi to guard her caravan.
Old DeBuke is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He is the father of Young DeBuke and can be found with her, fishing on the pier.
Olfim gro-Grazob is an Orsimer residing on the island of Betnikh. He is the banker at the Bank of Betnikh in Stonetooth Fortress.
Olfeigr the Fair is a Nord barbarian residing in Thirsk. She talks and acts in a drunken manner and greatly admires mead.
Onai-Ruul is an Argonian weaponsmith who resides in Hissmir, Shadowfen. She sells a variety of weapons at her shop called The Crossed Blades.
Olleg Selvayn is a Dunmer residing in the city of Ebonheart.
Ondicantar is an Altmer residing in The Veiled Keep in Errinorne Isle, Auridon.
Oleen-Jei is an Argonian commoner residing in Jin-Ei's House in the Sulfur Pools.
Olena is a Redguard clothier residing in the city of Shornhelm, Rivenspire. She can be found at the Shornhelm Smithy, selling her wares.
Olik-Jah is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Hissmir.
Olgol gro-Ladba is a character residing in the town of Wind Keep.
